zh.title: 拉脫維亞評估引進巴西航空工業A-29作為反無人機機種
zh.summary: 拉脫維亞評估採購巴西航空工業A-29；擬作為攔截低速無人機之防空戰力
body: 拉脫維亞空軍正在評估是否採購具備攔截無人機能力的輕型攻擊機，並將巴西航空工業（Embraer）的A-29「超級大嘴鳥」（Super Tucano）列為考慮平台之一。即將離任的拉脫維亞空軍司令維斯圖爾斯·馬蘇里斯（Viesturs Masulis）上校表示，軍方已接獲國防軍聯合參謀部的指示，負責尋求最有效的解決方案，並已與相關製造商接洽。
馬蘇里斯指出，拉脫維亞目前正等待業界提供財務與交機預估資料，以進行詳細分析並擬定後續可能行動方案。他建議繼任司令埃德蒙斯·斯文克斯（Edmunds Svenčs）上校，將此類機型主要定位為針對低速目標與無人機的空中防空資產。拉脫維亞政府已投入超過10億歐元用於加強整體防空建設，空中解決方案預計將成為該系統的組成部分之一。

en.title: Latvia Assesses Embraer A-29 Super Tucano for Counter-Drone Air Defense
en.summary: Latvian Air Force evaluates Embraer A-29 Super Tucano acquisition; targets airborne defense against slow-flying drones
body: The Latvian Air Force is evaluating the acquisition of light combat aircraft capable of intercepting unmanned aerial systems, with Embraer's A-29 Super Tucano identified as one candidate platform. Outgoing Air Force Commander Colonel Viesturs Masulis stated that the service received tasking from the National Armed Forces Joint Staff to determine effective counter-drone solutions, and preliminary contacts with aircraft manufacturers have already been initiated.

Latvia is currently awaiting financial and delivery estimates from defence manufacturers before conducting detailed analysis. Masulis noted that he would encourage incoming commander Colonel Edmunds Svenčs to focus on utilizing such platforms primarily as airborne air-defense assets against slow-flying drones. The Latvian government has committed over €1 billion toward strengthening overall air defense capability, with air-based solutions expected to complement the broader defense architecture.
